CREATE TABLE EDS.TRB_SEGMENT_DIM(
     TRB_SEGMENT_ID	int
    ,VERSION_NUM	int
    ,VERSION_NAME	varchar(80)
    ,LOW_LIMIT	decimal(15,2)
    ,TRB_BRACKET	varchar(80)
    ,SOURCE_CODE	varchar(20)
    ,INSERT_DTTM	datetime
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
    HEAP
)


CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_DID_TRB_SEGMENT_DIM]
( 
	[H] varchar(50),
    TRB_SEGMENT_ID	int,
    VERSION_NUM	int,
    VERSION_NAME	varchar(80),
    LOW_LIMIT	decimal(15,2),
    TRB_BRACKET	varchar(80),
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100),
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)


ALTER TABLE EDS.TRB_SEGMENT_DIM
ADD FILE_NAME VARCHAR(100)

select * into d360.TRB_SEGMENT_DIM_bu_20250225 from truncate table eds.TRB_SEGMENT_DIM

SELECT 'STG' tables,COUNT(*) cnt FROM D360.STG_EDS_DID_TRB_SEGMENT_DIM
union all
SELECT 'EDS' tables,COUNT(*) cnt FROM EDS.TRB_SEGMENT_DIM

select * from om.om_task_error_dtl where task_name = 'TSK_STG_EDS_TRB_SEGMENT_DIM'

select * from om.om_task_run where task_name like '%TRB_SEGMENT_DIM%' order by 9 desc
